title: Edge deployment mutation acknowledgement v1
description: Conditional proxy DELETE or API-spec PUT result. Consumers require HTTP 200, the expected deployment-v1 profile/target, durable=committed, live=applied and recovery_cleanup_authorized=true before automatic journal removal or dependent cleanup. From Edge v0.9.14, durable=unknown means only that the commit or its acknowledgement failed (or the settlement task was lost); pre-commit store failures report not_started or not_committed. Missing fields, refusal, cancellation and uncertain transport never authorize replay. Local application does not attest every remote DP.

x-contract.name: admin-deployment-mutation-acknowledgement
x-contract.edge_availability: Released since Ferrum Edge v0.9.12; unchanged shape re-read at v0.9.13 source 9b83115de7ec23ab51ec4feae6bed65e596db425, where a 507 NamespaceSnapshotTooLarge body reports durable not_started (snapshot read or pre-transaction check) or not_committed (rolled-back mutation transaction). Unchanged shape and durable enum re-read at v0.9.14 source 9bd4d5f9caa4ebe8f0ea13e76d8a6e2172eaca7d (ferrum-edge#6027, issue #6021): a 503 store failure before the mutation transaction opens reports not_started, one inside the rolled-back transaction reports not_committed, and only a failed commit or commit acknowledgement, or a lost settlement task, reports unknown. Edge v0.9.12 and v0.9.13 reported unknown for every 503 store failure. Unchanged shape and durable outcomes re-read at v0.9.15 source 25b37395ff61bfea0f3ffd189d9011c4984fa755.

provenance.note: Transcribed required members, optional profile/id/error and open object shape. The additional implication for cleanup authorization copies finish: true is emitted only after confirmed commit and applicable local application, final audit admission and lease release. HTTP status and profile/target matching remain consumer runtime checks. The durable meanings in the property description transcribe DeploymentMutationUnavailable.

durable.description: not_started: refused before the mutation transaction opened (mode, evidence or admission failure; from Edge v0.9.14 also a store read, transaction start or MongoDB mTLS admission refusal ahead of it; a 507 before the transaction). not_committed: raised inside the mutation transaction, which rolled back (stale evidence 412, graph or ownership refusal 409, a 507 inside the transaction; from Edge v0.9.14 also a lost namespace admission lease or a statement, admission or validation failure). committed: commit confirmed. unknown: from Edge v0.9.14 only a failed commit or commit acknowledgement, or a settlement task that never reports; Edge v0.9.12 and v0.9.13 also reported unknown for pre-commit store failures. No value authorizes cleanup or replay unless recovery_cleanup_authorized is true.

recovery_cleanup_authorized.description: True only after confirmed commit, applicable local live proof, final audit admission and namespace lease release. CP/unserved durable-only results are false even with HTTP 200.
